raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be on"
      role subject ?p
      role location "the 2nd floor"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a printer"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "work"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  select ?p

@s1 stated
  relation "be blocked"
  role subject "Mirela's printer"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
